## Equations
### EQ001 — Co-moving frequency transformation

*Maps laboratory frequency to the pump frame and defines every phase-matching root.*

$$
\omega'(\omega)=\omega-u\beta(\omega)
$$

status: `verified` · source: main_equation: Main Eq. (1)

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate fused-silica Sellmeier n(lambda), subtract the scalar capillary transverse mode term, derive u/c from the surrogate pump group index, and form omega-u beta. Sweep the explicit effective-core-radius assumption.
```

Code: `src/optical_hawking/physical_dispersion.py:CleanRoomPCFDispersion`

### EQ005 — Analytic-signal unidirectional propagation equation

*Advances the positive-frequency analytic field through the fibre.*

$$
i\partial_\zeta a_\omega+u\beta(\omega)a_\omega+u\gamma(a^3+3|a|^2a+3|a|^2a^*)_{\omega,+}=0
$$

### EQ007 — Sech-pulse power normalization

*Converts disclosed laser parameters into deterministic initial field amplitudes.*

$$
I(t)=P_0\,\mathrm{sech}^2(t/T_0),\quad T_0=\tau_{\mathrm{FWHM}}/1.762747,\quad P_0=E_p/(2T_0)
$$

status: `verified` · source: methods_parameters: pulse FWHM, average power, and 80 MHz repetition rate

Numerical form:

```
Pulse energy is average power divided by repetition rate; field amplitude is sqrt(power).
```

Code: `src/optical_hawking/model.py:PulseSpec`


### EQ008 — Power-law sideband amplitudes

*Turns ultrashort-pulse modulation into a geometric sideband ladder.*

$$
A_m=\widetilde g\,\frac{1-X^2}{1+X^2}(-iX)^{|m|},\quad X=\frac{\sqrt{1+(2\pi\chi)^2}-1}{2\pi\chi},\quad \chi=\Omega/\delta'
$$

status: `source_only` · derived from: `EQ005` · source: methods_equation: Eq. (C.3)

Numerical form:

```
Sum integer sideband orders from -10 through 10; omitted terms are below the plotted resolution for fitted X values.
```

### EQ009 — Backreaction sideband asymmetry

*Makes the band intensities asymmetric and exposes the backreaction contribution.*

$$
\widetilde g_m=\begin{cases}\widetilde g_-+i\widetilde g_B/X,&m<0,\\\widetilde g_- - i\widetilde g_B X,&m\ge 0.\end{cases}
$$

status: `source_only` · derived from: `EQ008`, `EQ004` · source: methods_equation: Eq. (C.4)

Numerical form:

```
Use |g_-|^2+|g_B|^2/X^2 for m<0 and |g_-|^2+|g_B|^2X^2 for m>=0 after incoherent averaging.
```

### EQ010 — Incoherently averaged Hawking spectrum

*Generates all six black theoretical curves in Nature Fig. 4.*

$$
I_{\mathrm{signal}}(\omega)\propto\sum_m|\widetilde g_m|^2X^{2|m|}I_H(\omega-\omega_m),\quad I_H(\nu)=1-\theta(\nu)^2,\quad \theta=\frac{\int_0^{\nu}\mathrm{sech}^2(v^\mu)\,dv}{\int_0^\infty\mathrm{sech}^2(v^\mu)\,dv}
$$

status: `source_only` · derived from: `EQ008`, `EQ009` · source: methods_equation: Eq. (D.1) and the following peak-profile definition

Numerical form:

```
Tabulate the normalized profile integral and evaluate a declared width/modulation/backreaction sensitivity grid for each of the six printed mu values. No source marker is a fit input.
```

$$
